basics.name: Kirill Demidov
basics.label: Data Engineering Lead | FinOps, Product Metrics & AI-Native Analytics
basics.summary: Data engineering lead who owns both sides of the platform: the product metrics decisions run on, and the cloud bill that produces them. Cut BigQuery spend by 50% through slot reservation redesign and per-team cost attribution, and run FinOps as a standing discipline — cost dashboards, query analyzers, and budget monitoring — not a one-off cleanup. 18 years in BI and data platforms, the last 6 leading teams in mobile gaming and adtech on GCP, now building AI-native tooling (MCP servers, agentic workflows) that keeps AI coding agents effective in a real codebase.

work.name: GOAT Entertainment Studios (HitZone Games, 1UP)
work.description: Gaming holding operating two studios and their live titles: HitZone Games (Invokers, invokers.com) and 1UP, formerly Guns & Gangs (Urban Heat, urbanheat.gg).
work.summary: Own the analytics platform behind both live titles of the holding — Invokers (HitZone Games) and Urban Heat (1UP): Dataform/BigQuery modelling, revenue and UA data marts, data quality, self-service BI, GCP cost ownership, and production ML for game balance.
highlights: Own the analytics warehouse: 254 Dataform/BigQuery models across product, finance, marketing, and monitoring, with 125 automated data-quality assertions.
Brought store revenue in-house — a daily Apple/Google reconciliation that matches the finance golden source to the cent, and caught a double-counting bug that had inflated reported revenue.
Built the UA/marketing mart — attribution, creative-level cost, cohort revenue and retention — as the single source of truth for spend decisions.
Built and run a self-service BI portal (Python/FastAPI on Cloud Run) serving 12 dashboards to product, finance, and UA, with pipeline observability and Slack alerting.
Built Hero Index and a RAPM-style ML model (Cloud Run) that replaced subjective balance votes with 15.67M real battles, lifting the PvE balance signal from 0.56 to 0.85 correlation.
Own GCP FinOps for the data platform — cut BigQuery spend by 50% through a slot reservation redesign (400-slot baseline vs. 700+ peak), with no loss of query performance for downstream teams.

Made cloud cost visible and owned: built a BigQuery cost dashboard and a query analyzer that attribute spend to teams, queries, and pipelines, turning an opaque monthly bill into per-owner accountability.

Led the GitLab→GitHub monorepo migration (29 repos → 3) and introduced the Service Brain Pattern — a pre-development documentation standard that keeps AI coding agents and engineers aligned on service context.

projects.name: Three Readings: open parliamentary data platform
projects.description: Built and run a platform that collects, normalizes and analyzes legislative data from seven parliaments (Russia's State Duma, Israel's Knesset, Germany's Bundestag, Sweden's Riksdag, US Congress, US state legislatures, Spain's Congreso) and opens it to people and AI agents.
highlights: 1.8M+ bills, 1.3M+ roll-call votes, 190K amendments and 43K plenary transcripts, synced daily from official APIs and sites into per-parliament PostgreSQL schemas.
MCP server per parliament lets Claude and ChatGPT query the data directly; LLM features include bill summaries, document parsing and natural-language reports.
Per-parliament multilingual sites (Flask + React/MUI on Cloud Run) at sozd., kns., bundestag. and riksdag.threereadings.org, plus a shared knowledge base.
Cross-parliament comparison layer behind parliaments.compare and a seat-allocation calculator (electoral-calc.org) on ParlGov and CLEA election data.
Ops: GitHub Actions to GHCR and Docker on a VPS, Cloud Run via Workload Identity; service schedules driven from the DB; OpenAI/GCP/DigitalOcean cost monitoring and Telegram alerting.

FastAPI site on Cloud Run (BigQuery + GCS), phrase search, school compare, calendar export, Telegram bot and an MCP server for AI agents.

Collectors for BTL membership, MoH services and clinic expertise, plus LLM-assisted question answering on the public site.
